summary: Caring Brands, Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01 Other Events) to correct an inadvertent error in its previously filed Definitive Proxy Statement. The record date for the annual meeting of stockholders was incorrectly stated as May 12, 2026, and is corrected to May 14, 2026. No other information changes. The company will file a revised proxy statement. This is a routine clerical correction, not a special situation. No deal terms, no recommendation, no risk-arb angle.
